# facts flow through Normalize with zero downstream changes

Verifies that extracted TypeScript facts, when passed through the Normalize step, produce the same entity/relationship outcomes expected by downstream systems. The test builds a small set of files, runs the analyzer and normalize, and asserts the presence of component slugs and relationships (contains, covers) and that there are no warnings.
